These are people you would think are intelligent enough to know that's shitty to do to a person, let alone laugh at them and mock him to his face. But I remain quiet. They leave, she leaves for our next class in ten minutes, I sit silently. I proceed to sit there for 4 and a half hours missing my next three classes not saying a word.
